name: 秘塔AI搜索
desc: 无广告直达结果的生成式 AI 搜索
desc_zh: 无广告直达结果的生成式 AI 搜索
solves: Chinese search results are ads you have to scroll past before the answer. It drops the ads and puts the answer at the top.
solves_zh: 中文搜索结果页前面全是广告，你得先划过去才能看到答案。秘塔把广告去掉，答案直接放在最上面。
best_for: When you want a Chinese-language answer without the sponsored links sitting between you and it.
best_for_zh: 当你想要一个中文答案，而不想中间夹着赞助链接时。
